title: Men in suits visit Puharich at Intelectron the day JFK was shot
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of Men in suits visit Puharich at Intelectron the day JFK was shot, about 1963 at Intelectron office, New York City, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: told me a story that she was working at Intelectron the day JFK was assassinated and that these men in suits she says came into the offices went into Puharich's office
